# Image inventory

Rules applied: homepage hero is text-only; images appear only in content sections; no AI-generated people, no stock photos presented as our staff or clients, no RBI/bank logos or seals, no cash/handcuff imagery. Every content image has width/height (no layout shift), descriptive alt text, lazy loading below the fold, and WebP variants (480/800/1200) via `<picture>`/`srcset`.

## Original illustrations (`assets/illustrations/`, generated by `tools/illustrations.mjs`)

| File | Used on | Content source |
|---|---|---|
| `how-we-work.svg` | Homepage (About), About | Our process (no outcome claims) |
| `settlement-timeline.svg` | Process, OTS | Process page; RBI framework (3-month rule) |
| `settlement-documents.svg` | Personal loan settlement | Settlement paperwork checklist |
| `settlement-or-restructuring.svg` | MSME, Settlement vs restructuring | Decision guide (no promises) |
| `settled-vs-closed.svg` | Credit report guidance | Status definitions |
| `recovery-rules-2027.svg` | Recovery agent page, RBI 2027 pillar | RBI/2026-27/223 & /230 (verified) |
| `complaint-escalation.svg` | Recovery agent page, Loan app page | RB-IOS 2026; cybercrime.gov.in / 1930 |
| `minimum-due-cycle.svg` | Credit card settlement | Concept only, no figures |
| `section-138-timeline.svg` | Cheque bounce | NI Act ss.138/142 |

Text in the SVGs uses system fonts. If a rule changes, edit `tools/illustrations.mjs` and re-run `node tools/illustrations.mjs`.

## Generated cards (`tools/media.mjs`, needs Chrome)

| Folder | What | Size |
|---|---|---|
| `assets/og/<slug>.jpg` | 1200×630 share card for every page (title + brand) | ~80 KB each |
| `assets/thumbs/<slug>.webp`, `<slug>-1200.webp` | Guide thumbnails and guide header images (category colour + icon + title) | 600×400 / 1200×800 |

Re-run `node tools/media.mjs [slug…]` after changing a page H1.
